test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five sisters S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a straight line facing north. V is sitting second to the right of S. W is sitting second to the left of T. V sits at the right end of the row. Who is sitting exactly in the middle of the row?
solution:
**Given: **Five sisters S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a straight line facing north. 

1) V sits at the right end of the row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d644e95a202b18adc7cce33f0de5e20a835e7c46d5ccd69655b76ad12cdc73c.png] 

2) V is sitting second to the right
